title: course instruction overlays for type-specific review patterns
description: Add optional instruction overlays for math (and future) course types. Instead of forking course-review.md / synthesis.md entirely, allow a course to specify instruction_overlay: math in its config. The overlay lives in instructions/overlays/ and is appended to the base prompt at build time, covering only what's different (LaTeX handling, worked-example extraction, proof-summary format). Base instructions remain the single source of truth for shared behavior. Depends on L58 (math instruction evaluation).
